Notification No. NPSC/EXAM-11/CESE/2021 dt. 16.11.2026 ( CESE 2026 Disability Certificate Re-verification) 
 Published on : 16-11-2026 03:48 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 NAGALAND: KOHIMA 
No. NPSC/EXAM-11/CESE/2021 Dated Kohima, the 16 th 
November, 2026 
 NOTIFICATION 
 In continuation
with Advertisement No.NPSC-1/CESE-2026 dated 29 . 04.2026 &
addendum dated 12.05.2026, this is to notify that the Re-verification of
Disability Certificate of shortlisted PwBD candidates for Common Educational
Services Examination 2026, will be conducted on Wednesday the 18 th November, 2026 at Naga Hospital Authority Kohima. 
 The
concerned candidates are directed to report at the OPD with INTERVIEW CALL LETTER and DISABILITY CERTIFICATE in latest format 
at Naga Hospital Authority Kohima at 10:00 A.M.
